name: persistent-context-workspace
description: Explicit project-memory cycles with temporary context and human-approved knowledge

interface.shortDescription: Persistent external context for long-running work.
interface.longDescription: Read approved project knowledge first, retain work in temporary context and review permanent changes before applying them. Clear temporary context at cycle start and finish.
defaultPrompt: Use $pcw to prepare project knowledge and the current task.
Use $pcw to continue the task using existing project memory.
